Llms.details: Dying Star is developed by volunteers on the Godot engine (open source, double precision build). The project relies on open source, participatory democracy (the community votes on major decisions) and artistic integrity: the use of AI in artistic creations is prohibited. Anyone can join and contribute, whatever their skills.
Llms.summary: Dying Star is an open-source space MMO simulation game, created by the community, for the community, with an immersive and collaborative narrative universe.
